messages:
maria: Hey team, small ops ask before sprint launch — we keep seeing small docs PRs landing with no reviewer. Two ideas: a lightweight on-call for quick fixes, plus explicit merge windows for larger docs that touch SDKs. Thoughts?
josh: On-call sounds good. How do you define 'quick'? < 10 lines? single-file?
maria: proposal: label `docs-quick` = single-file & < 20 lines, `docs-major` = multi-file or code samples changed. Quick gets auto-assigned to on-call reviewer. Major requires at least 2 reviewers (docs + eng).
lee: Re: merge windows, can we avoid 9am-11am PT? That's when infra runs backups and preview can be slow. Maybe 11:30am-1:30pm PT for docs merges to avoid overlapping.
sam: I can be on-call for quick fixes this sprint if we automate assignment. Also happy to be the runtime reviewer for major SDK changes.
ara: I can add GH Action to auto-assign on label add. I'd use a tiny action that looks up a rota file in repo (`.github/docs-oncall.json`) and assigns. Sample step I plan to add: action uses `peter-evans/assign` with a matrix lookup.
ora: (typo: ara here) Example snippet I'll propose in infra PR: 
```yaml
on: pull_request_target
jobs:
  auto-assign:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: assign on docs-quick
        uses: peter-evans/assign@v2
        if: contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'docs-quick')
        with:
          assignees: ${{ fromJson(needs.lookup.outputs.oncall)[github.event.repository] }}
```
maria: Nice. One more wrinkle: linkcheck flakiness from the external CDN is tripping previews. For flaky external links, prefer canonical stable redirects where possible, or add `skip-linkcheck: true` in frontmatter and file an issue to re-validate monthly.
josh: Agreed. Also can we add a tiny checklist to the PR template reminding authors to add `docs-quick` when appropriate and to add `preview: required` for major changes.
lee: I'll update the CONTRIBUTING.md with the on-call description and add the merge window note. Also will add a `review-buddy` checkbox so authors pick a partner for major migrations.
sam: For today's backlog: I can take #3268 (SDK token example fix) as a quick; violet can do #3271 (table formatting) and then on-call gets auto-assigned for anything else labeled docs-quick.
violet: Happy to. Tag me `@violet` and I'll look in the afternoon.
docs-bot: Automated: Created issue #481 (docs oncall rotation) from form submission — https://go.internal/issues/481
maria: Great. I'll open the infra PR for the action and update the rota file. Also scheduling a 15-min sync tomorrow to finalize the rota (invite sent).
josh: One operational thing: after a major merge please run `/run-docs-preview` and post the preview URL here. Sometimes previews don't reflect latest cache until invalidated.
maria: Will do. Thanks all — shipping the on-call infra PR now and adding the short CONTRIBUTING blurb. If anyone sees a stalled quick PR, ping me directly.
sam: Claimed #3268 and added `docs-quick`.
violet: Claimed #3271.
lee: Opening CONTRIBUTING PR now — small paragraph + note about merge window.
ara: Infra PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/912 — contains GH Action and `.github/docs-oncall.json` format.
maria: Excellent. Sync tomorrow at 10:30 PT to finalize the first rotation. Bye for now. :wave:
